title: Syllabus Overview
notes: Unit 15: Aromatic Hydrocarbons · Organic Chemistry · 6 teaching hours

• Introduction and characteristics of aromatic compounds
  • Huckel's rule of aromaticity
  • Kekule structure of benzene
  • Resonance and isomerism
  • Preparation of benzene (decarboxylation of sodium benzoate, phenol, ethyne)
  • Physical properties of benzene
  • Chemical properties of benzene: Addition reactions, Electrophilic substitution reactions (nitration, sulphonation, halogenation, Friedel-Crafts alkylation/acylation), orientation of derivatives (o, m, p), combustion, and uses
